tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The Grandstream GRP2612W WiFi HD IP Phone with Adapter is a powerful and professional-grade business communication solution designed for modern offices, enterprises, call centers, and remote work environments. Featuring built-in dual-band WiFi connectivity, crystal-clear HD audio, and support for up to 4 SIP accounts, the GRP2612W delivers reliable and efficient VoIP communication without requiring wired network installation.

Designed as part of Grandstream's carrier-grade GRP series, this IP phone offers enterprise-level security, centralized management through GDMS, and advanced telephony features to enhance productivity. Its sleek design, intuitive user interface, and high-performance capabilities make it an ideal choice for businesses seeking a dependable IP telephony solution.

Key Features


  • Supports 4 SIP accounts and 2 line keys
  • Built-in dual-band 2.4GHz & 5GHz WiFi
  • HD audio on handset and speakerphone
  • Noise Shield technology for clearer conversations
  • Full-duplex speakerphone with acoustic echo cancellation
  • 2 Gigabit Ethernet ports with integrated PoE support
  • 2.4-inch color LCD display (320 x 240)
  • Electronic Hook Switch (EHS) support for wireless headsets
  • Enterprise-grade security with secure boot and encrypted data storage
  • GDMS cloud management and provisioning support
  • Compatible with major SIP-based VoIP platforms
